configuration.junos:comment: /* junoscfg-oracle: the configuration junoscfg is judged against. Every Junos construct its converters must carry through set, curly, XML and JSON (groups, wildcards, apply-*, tags, annotations, quoting, keyed entries, the statements a schema cannot place), routing and system material for the anonymizer, and an ELS switching section. Written for junoscfg; values are its test-data conventions (AS 64496-64511; 10.x, 192.168.x and 198.51.100.x kept; 203.0.114.x, 198.0.2.x and 3ffe:b00::/32 anonymized). Its secrets are invented and public. Loaded on lab devices in configure private and rolled back there; the devices' renderings of it are the test oracle. The switching (ELS) section uses interfaces of its own (xe-*, ae1, irb.110). A device that refuses a statement drops the rest of its enclosing block, so each platform's renderings show what that platform keeps. */
/* apply-flags omit hides a statement's content in curly output; a group of its own, not applied, so nothing else is hidden */
